Hero_Desc_Levi:
A witch who works, and works, and works nonstop.
The witches treat Levi as the youngest and make her do all kinds of chores.
She always looks tired.
Album_Like_Levi: Accidentally discovering little tricks. Taking a rest on the sneak.
Album_Wish_Levi: Living like a tycoon in a world beyond money.
Album_Levi1: A lesser witch who is constantly on the move. As the youngest of the witches, she may seem very naive, but she has a reputation for her sincerity among them.
Album_Levi2: Levi has been stuck in the 'internship' for as long as she can remember. She seeks to be recognized as a certified witch from the superior witches, offering her services without pay... It brings tears to my eyes.
Album_Levi3: Levi is working part-time at Posher's potion shop, saying that of all the witches she's met, Posher treats her the best. Although, it seems like she's the test subject for the new potions... But Levi seems unaware that is the case.
Album_Levi4: I asked Levi what the best thing was about becoming a certified witch. She said she didn't really know, implying she was avoiding answering on purpose.
Album_Levi5: I discovered Levi possesses extraordinary abilities. Contrary to her appearance, she can unleash monumental strength and speed. Since she believes these are the side effects from the potion experiments, so she doesn't adequately use her powers.
Album_Levi6: Levi occasionally takes Posher's weakening potions to suppress her own strength. When I suggested correctly using her hidden abilities might make her a certified witch, she replied that mere strength doesn't mean one becomes certified.
Album_Levi7: Levi always says, "With great power comes great responsibility." But then she immediately follows up with, "That's why I'll just stay weak and only take on small responsibilities." She's not trying to become a Certified Witch to rise through the ranks. She says she just wants to "live comfortably and collect a pension."
LoveHero_Levi:
You're offering me a part-time job? If you pay me
my wage on time,
I'll do anything.
LoveHeroCancel_Levi:
Ugh...
It really was a sweet gig
but it was all in vain...
Please call me again next time.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Hate1: Saying she had tried a potion with a similar flavor profile, Levi grumbled that she was traumatized.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Hate2: Levi doesn't like the smell of this dish. She mumbled a tearful story about remembering when her house burned down.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like1: After trying the fried carrots one time, Levi came back every night at midnight and went on a rampage, demanding the discarded portions.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like2:
Levi liked this cheap and tasty food.
Wanting to try working in a sprite bakery, she put up notices on the walls, announcing her search for part-time work.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like3: Levi timidly asked me if she could have 'more' of this food. I told her to take as much as she wanted.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like4: She was delighted just to have the chance to eat this kind of food, saying this seasonal menu was available only for a short period of time.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like5: She was a bit hesitant at first, wondering if it was too precious to eat, but she tried it after some encouragement and liked it.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like6: Levi hoped to receive such good food more often.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like7: Levi says just one bowl of rice cake soup fills her up. She's relieved that she can work through another day without trouble.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like8: With a single tear in her eyes, Levi says the sweetness reminded her of a Certified Witch Appointment Letter while the bitterness reminded her of piled-up papers.
Food_ChefNote_Levi_Like9: Levi mentioned this color tastes like tears. That color tastes like hard work. That color tastes like all-nighters. Confusing whether it's sad or good, she just kept eating.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Levi: How many tasks are left today?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Levi:
Yes, hello??
Is there a reason you called?
Gacha_Result_Line2_Levi: My prized possession? My bank account
Levi_Spawn: Y-yes? Why did you call me?
Levi_Spawn2: A special part-time job! This is a rare opportunity!
Levi_Growth1: I'm feeling a little bit more powerful!
Levi_Growth2: You are not going to give me more work just because I became stronger, are you?
Levi_Victory1: Victory! So do I get a raise?
Levi_Victory2: Haha, that's one job out of the way!
Levi_Defeat1: There's no fine for losing, right?
Levi_Affinity1_1: I hope this internship ends soon...
Levi_Affinity1_2: I'm tired, *sob*... Gotta work overtime today.
Levi_Affinity2: Another all-nighter... yesterday too... and tomorrow!
Levi_Affinity1_3: Can someone else do the menial work?
Levi_Affinity3: The reinvigoration potions Posher makes have too many side effects.
Levi_Affinity4: Don't talk to me! I'm busy!
Levi_Affinity5: What? Interns don't get extra pay?
Levi_Affinity6: Argh! Please, no more loading and unloading!
Levi_Affinity7: A promotion? Huh? You mean it's a paid internship?
Levi_Die: You will still pay me for the day, right?
Levi_Die1: You're still paying me for today, right?
Levi_Die2: I guess I wasn't good enough...
Levi_LevelUp: I wonder if I can take another part-time job now?
Levi_HeroSkill: Isn't there a way to upgrade the slacking off skill?
Levi_HeroUpgrade: Am I a full-time employee... yet?
Levi_Board: Got it! I'll be right there!
Levi_DeckSetting1: Gotta hide behind the strong guys...
Levi_Stage: I can't clock out and go home because of them!
Levi_Touch2_1: Well, it's better than getting pinched.
Levi_Touch1_2: Is this like a rod of love?
Levi_Touch2: I'd be grateful if you give me money instead of petting me...
Levi_Touch2_2: Hehe, please keep looking after me.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Levi_Skin1: Levi even works part-time at the elven theater, which now has a branch in the Witch Kingdom. Just how many part-time jobs does she have?!
Levi_Growth1_Skin1: Tickets for sale. Cheaper than scalped tickets.
Levi_Growth2_Skin1: The early-bird discount applies. It is as cheap as my salary.
Levi_LevelUp_Skin1: For more accurate ticketing than a kiosk!
Levi_Equipment_Skin1: The uniform is pretty, so I do like it a bit.
Levi_HeroSkill_Skin1: How about a bucket of fried carrots instead of popcorn?
Levi_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Did I grow taller than Renewa?
Levi_Board_Skin1: Is it cleaning time? Which hall is this?
Levi_Touch1_Skin1: Are you dissatisfied with our service?
Levi_Touch1_1_Skin1: Please file your complaints through proper channels or just talk it out!
Levi_Touch1_2_Skin1: Ah! That really snapped me back to my senses!
Levi_Touch2_Skin1: I'm feeling energized thanks to you! Hehe
Levi_Touch2_1_Skin1: I guess you liked this week's movie recommendation?
Levi_Touch2_2_Skin1: Ah... It would be great if we only had customers like you, Master.
Levi_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Argh! Don't bully an innocent part-timer!
Levi_SkillCast: I can feel power throughout my body!
Levi_SPSkill1: Think you can dodge my technique?
Levi_Ultimate1_1: I never thought I would have to bring this out.
Levi_Ultimate1_1-01: I never thought I would have to bring this out.
Levi_Ultimate1: I will show you my finishing move.
Levi_Gacha2: Hm? Why did you call me?
Levi_Gacha3: How many tasks are left today?
Levi_Line1: I should work hard today too.
LoveLetter_Levi: I once had a part-time job writing chain letters, but writing something like this feels like a first... or maybe it's just been ages since the last one. Oh, I did write that petition for the witch promotion exam, but writing for fun like this? That's definitely new. Thanks to you opening up the Banquet Hall, I've been able to have a balanced diet. It gave me the energy to pick up two new part-time jobs! Thank you! From, Levi
LoveCall_Levi:
Hello, Master. It is me, Levi.
I had a break during my part-time job, so I called. The shop is unusually quiet today.
Normally, I would use every spare moment to write my thesis or finish assignments, but today I found myself thinking of you.

Have you been well? I am still busy writing my thesis and working part-time.
You have been very busy lately too.
Master, I am confident in any part-time job. Whenever the Order is busy, call me without hesitation. I cannot promise that for other employers... but for you, I will always find the time.

Whoa! Customers suddenly flooded in! I have to go! See you next time, Master!
Affinity_Levi_EP01_001: What's the pay for part-time work here?
Affinity_Levi_EP01_002: Everyone here works out of the goodness of their hearts, so no one gets paid.
Affinity_Levi_EP01_003: Ahh, "goodness of their hearts"? People here work like a "family," right? Places like this are a dime a dozen.
Affinity_Levi_EP01_004: We pay the minimum hourly wage set by Sprite Kingdom.
Affinity_Levi_EP01_005: Lawful, aren't you? Well, glad to see you're honest.
Affinity_Levi_EP01_006: Name your price. I'll pay you whatever you want.
Affinity_Levi_EP01_007:
Hmm... Are you stringing me along? I'm not that capable of a witch to name my own price or anything.
Don't try to scam me!
Affinity_Levi_EP02_001: Sprites... Witches... Werebeasts... Elves...? Why do they all hate each other?
Affinity_Levi_EP02_002: I guess it's hard for them to understand each other.
Affinity_Levi_EP02_003: Understand each other? The moment pay is exchanged, you have a natural vested interest in one another!
Affinity_Levi_EP02_004: Work with me to resolve the strange disputes they all have...
Affinity_Levi_EP02_005: You want me to work with you? Are you gonna pay me? If not, don't bother asking.
Affinity_Levi_EP02_007: Sprites? I don't mind them. The only ones I hate are employers who run away without paying me my wages.
Affinity_Levi_EP03_001: I'm not used to being treated so well. I feel weird every time I come here.
Affinity_Levi_EP03_002: It's no big deal, so don't worry about it.
Affinity_Levi_EP03_003: I know it's not a big deal. Like I said, I'm just not used to this.
Affinity_Levi_EP03_004: Don't worry about such things and just come whenever you're hungry,
Affinity_Levi_EP03_005:
*Sob...* Is this what societal warmth feels like?
You're not going to spring a nasty surprise on me later and give me a whole bunch of bills, are you?
Affinity_Levi_EP03_006: Who said you're getting this for free? Don't you have a job to get to?
Affinity_Levi_EP03_007: So this is the bitter taste of harsh reality. It's true... nothing in the world is free.
Affinity_Levi_EP04_001: Witch Kingdom is way too brutal. I want to live as leisurely as the sprites do.
Affinity_Levi_EP04_002: Why don't you just move here?
Affinity_Levi_EP04_003: What about all the work I'm doing? It's not like you are going to take responsibility for them.
Affinity_Levi_EP04_004: Is there nothing redeeming about the Witch Kingdom?
Affinity_Levi_EP04_005:
If you're at the top, there's a lot of great things. The problem is that I'm at the bottom.
I swear I'll make my way up there one day.
Affinity_Levi_EP04_006: Why don't you cut back on your workload?
Affinity_Levi_EP04_007: But... if I don't work, I can't make a living. I don't want to end up out on the streets.
Affinity_Levi_EP05_001: What do I have to do to be well off without having to work?
Affinity_Levi_EP05_002: Does something like that even exist? Don't hope for the impossible.
Affinity_Levi_EP05_003: It's only impossible because you think it is! I can dream, can't I?
Affinity_Levi_EP05_004: So you want to beg for money or something?
Affinity_Levi_EP05_005: Begging for money is a full-time job. I said I didn't want to work. Geez, you're clueless!
Affinity_Levi_EP05_006: Leeching off someone might be the only way...
Affinity_Levi_EP05_007: Um... where do you live, Master? Can I have your address, please?
Affinity_Levi_EP06_001: It's always hard to deal with obnoxious customers. Do you have to deal with any here?
Affinity_Levi_EP06_002: Of course I do. I can't say who, though...
Affinity_Levi_EP06_003: I have a feeling it's the same one who always comes to the shop I work at... Keep your spirits high, Master.
Affinity_Levi_EP06_004: Nope. My customers are nothing but cute.
Affinity_Levi_EP06_005: Sure. If such self-rationalization makes you feel better, go ahead.
Affinity_Levi_EP06_006: If I see anyone like that, I just kick them out. The end.
Affinity_Levi_EP06_007: They say the customer is king, though? Can we do that? Running a business is so tough.
Affinity_Levi_EP07_001: How can I increase my wages?
Affinity_Levi_EP07_003: Wow, that's some constructive, yet hollow advice.
Affinity_Levi_EP07_004: You need luck. It can produce good results.
Affinity_Levi_EP07_005: Ugh... this luck-driven world...! You even have to work on developing your luck!
Affinity_Levi_EP07_006: By flattery and fawning over your superiors.
Affinity_Levi_EP07_007: Flattery only works once or twice. Doing it too often can backfire.
Affinity_Levi_EP08_001: Since I'm a customer here... you think I can go on a power trip just once?
Affinity_Levi_EP08_002: Do something like that and I'll kick you out right away.
Affinity_Levi_EP08_003: I wanted to feel superior for once...
Affinity_Levi_EP08_004: Cute. As if you could be that obnoxious. But sure, give it a go.
Affinity_Levi_EP08_005:
Ugh! What's with the food in this garbage dump?!
Let me speak to your manager and have them tear this dump down! Now!
Affinity_Levi_EP08_006: Levi, are things that rough for you? Something like that is a wish of yours?
Affinity_Levi_EP08_007: Master...! Why is life so hard?
Affinity_Levi_EP09_001: If I keep working hard, I'll become a regular full-time employee someday, right?
Affinity_Levi_EP09_002: Ahh, don't you know? When you finish your internship... you will become a contract worker!
Affinity_Levi_EP09_003: I don't wanna hear the truth! Just tell me what I want to hear! Waaah!
Affinity_Levi_EP09_004: I'll throw you a party when you become a full-time employee.
Affinity_Levi_EP09_005: *Sob* Thank you! On that note, would you like to hire a full-time employee, boss?
Affinity_Levi_EP09_006: Well... shouldn't you inquire with your boss for a clear answer?
Affinity_Levi_EP09_007: The thought of her saying no would be too much for me to handle mentally... s-so, I've decided not to ask!
Affinity_Levi_EP10_001: I want to work in moderation and find a decent level of happiness in life. Why does it feel like such a challenge?"
Affinity_Levi_EP10_002: C'mon, if you're going to work, you might as well give it everything you've got.
Affinity_Levi_EP10_003: If I do that, I'll end up taking on everything! I'll collapse from overwork!
Affinity_Levi_EP10_004: You should be thankful for each and every day.
Affinity_Levi_EP10_005: Ugh, that's what a patronizing person would say. If I worked every day, I'd be too busy to feel thankful!
Affinity_Levi_EP10_006: Don't let anyone know you're good at your job.
Affinity_Levi_EP10_007:
Can I do that? Okay, I'll give it a go!
I'll start by slacking off on the errands you give me!
Affinity_Levi_EP11_001: Ugh... I don't wanna work. What should I do...?
Affinity_Levi_EP11_003: If I could do that, I wouldn't have said what I just said in the first place!
Affinity_Levi_EP11_004: See if someone can fill in for you.
Affinity_Levi_EP11_005: Hmm... In that case, would you mind covering my shift today?
Affinity_Levi_EP11_007: *Sob...* Let's eat something delicious and cheer each other up...
Affinity_Levi_EP12_001: What do you do when you wanna slack off at work, Master?
Affinity_Levi_EP12_002: Pretend you're sick and go visit Hilde.
Affinity_Levi_EP12_003: I've used fake doctor's notes too often, so I don't think I can pull that trick anymore. *Sob*
Affinity_Levi_EP12_004: Offload your work onto a colleague or subordinate without them realizing.
Affinity_Levi_EP12_005: Oh! Just doing the bare minimum before casually dumping the work on someone else? I'm pretty good at that!
Affinity_Levi_EP12_007: Huh? You mean you don't slack off at all? Don't be pretentious!
Affinity_Levi_EP13_001: Master! Who's the most memorable customer you've ever had in the banquet hall?
Affinity_Levi_EP13_003: Huh? Really? I find difficult customers the most memorable... Don't tell me I was the difficult one?
Affinity_Levi_EP13_004: Everyone who has visited this place.
Affinity_Levi_EP13_005: You remember every single customer? Just how few customers do you have?! Now I'm jealous...
Affinity_Levi_EP13_006: Customers who really enjoyed the food.
Affinity_Levi_EP13_007: I can't forget that one customer who devoured 150 fried carrots, that's for sure... Even if it's factory-prepped, it's still food I personally handled.
Affinity_Levi_EP14_001: When will I ever escape from being a low-ranked witch? *Sigh*
Affinity_Levi_EP14_002: In the very distant future, maybe?
Affinity_Levi_EP14_003: Master... You didn't have to be so blunt about that! Waaah!
Affinity_Levi_EP14_005: I know it's just empty words, but still, that's nice to hear. Hehe...
Affinity_Levi_EP14_006: When a new intern witch joins under you.
Affinity_Levi_EP14_007: ...You're just stating the obvious. I'm not sure what to say.
Affinity_Levi_EP15_001: Picora can be surprisingly ambitious. Why does she aim for such lofty goals?
Affinity_Levi_EP15_002: Hey, dreaming is free, isn't it?
Affinity_Levi_EP15_003: That's... true. It's not like dreaming costs any money.
Affinity_Levi_EP15_005: No, thanks. There's nothing better than the steady joy of reaching small goals!
Affinity_Levi_EP15_006: Picora probably doesn't think they're grandiose.
Affinity_Levi_EP15_007: Well... She's kind of a weirdo, y'know. I can't imagine living such an exhausting life.
Affinity_Levi_EP16_001: I have no choice but to pull an all-nighter today, but I'm so sleepy... What should I do?
Affinity_Levi_EP16_002: How about asking Posher for a potion?
Affinity_Levi_EP16_003: I don't want to pull all-nighters forever...
Affinity_Levi_EP16_004: Get some sleep first. You can worry about that later.
Affinity_Levi_EP16_005: No! Don't tempt me! I have a pile of overdue theses...
Affinity_Levi_EP16_006: Want me to keep you company?
Affinity_Levi_EP16_007: Well... Having someone to talk to would certainly make me less sleepy!
Affinity_Levi_EP17_001: What kind of customers usually come here? Part-time jobs can get harder or easier depending on who you're dealing with.
Affinity_Levi_EP17_003: Ah... so you're going through the same pain I am. Nothing's ever easy, is it? Stay strong.
Affinity_Levi_EP17_005: You can make canned food, too? You've got more skills than I thought. This is why it's great to be a jack of all trades.
Affinity_Levi_EP17_007: No wonder the banquet hall was reeking of sugar... You should probably get some ventilation going.
Affinity_Levi_EP18_001: Ms. Posher gave me a new potion as a gift, but I have no idea what it does.
Affinity_Levi_EP18_002: Maybe it's a potion that boosts efficiency?
Affinity_Levi_EP18_003: Oh... Would you like to try it, Master? I'm suddenly feeling a bit queasy...
Affinity_Levi_EP18_005: Huh? But this is what I got instead of getting paid for yesterday. Who's going to compensate me for the day I lost, then? Will you do it, Master?
Affinity_Levi_EP18_007: Hmm, alright. Nothing was ever wrong with Ms. Posher's potions... I think?
Affinity_Levi_EP19_001: I want to escape this repetitive life of doing the same part-time jobs... Maybe it's time to look for a new one?
Affinity_Levi_EP19_002: Just focus on the job you have right now.
Affinity_Levi_EP19_003: That's not a bad idea. Learning something new is also a kind of labor, after all.
Affinity_Levi_EP19_004: How about finding a more active job?
Affinity_Levi_EP19_005: I'm not that choosy with jobs, but... just thinking about it alone drains my energy.
Affinity_Levi_EP19_006: You should think about becoming a certified witch.
Affinity_Levi_EP19_007: Oh... you're right. I think I've just gotten used to being a part-timer and nothing more.
Affinity_Levi_EP20_001: Is there any sweet gig where you don't have to do anything to get paid?
Affinity_Levi_EP20_002: The world isn't that easy, kiddo.
Affinity_Levi_EP20_003: I know, I know. But just the hope that there might be one out there somewhere is enough to keep me going.
Affinity_Levi_EP20_004: I'm sure you could ask Jubee if you're looking for something sweet.
Affinity_Levi_EP20_005: ...Mind if I act like one of those angry customers who cause a scene?
Affinity_Levi_EP20_006: When I become rich one day, I can hire you.
Affinity_Levi_EP20_007: Oh! Shall we write an employment contract in advance so that you don't backpedal later?
